question.question: In standard setup how are starting player/seating, score markers and dice arranged, and does faction setup order set turn order?

expected.expected_answer: Random starting player and seating; score markers zero; dice near map. Faction setup letter order distinct from random turn order.

source_passages.section: Setup — Standard Setup — starting player and seating
source_passages.quotation: 1. Choose factions; determine starting player and seating randomly. Take faction boards and their listed pieces. Use Fall or Winter. Fall has no special rules; on Winter, the river divides forests just as printed paths do. Rivers are otherwise not paths.

source_passages.section: Setup — Standard Setup — overview cards and dice
source_passages.quotation: 6. Distribute overview cards as desired; put battle dice nearby.
7. Set up factions in their letter order: Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond. Setup order is distinct from turn order.

answer.ruling: Choose factions and determine starting player and seating randomly.
Put score markers at 0. Distribute overview cards as desired and put battle dice nearby.
Set up factions in letter order Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond; this setup order is distinct from turn order.
